meta.name: add-signal
meta.description: Add Signal channel integration via signal-cli device-link. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 Signal 消息渠道，实现原生收发。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用里直接收发 Signal 消息。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Signal channel for native messaging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to send and receive Signal messages in your app.

howto.what: 装好后,NanoClaw 接入 Signal:在手机上扫码把它连为 Signal 副设备,助手便用该手机号收发私聊、群聊消息,也接收你发给自己的 Note to Self。
howto.when: 当你想把 Signal 加为助手渠道时进入,通常发生在 /setup 流程中或单独接入账号时;之后用 /init-first-agent 或 /manage-channels 接线。

say.text: 帮我把 Signal 接入,扫码链接我的账号
say.note: 安装 signal-cli 并打印链接二维码

say.text: 把 Signal 上这个群接到我的 agent
say.note: 为该群建 wiring,messages 有记录后生效

say.text: 给 Signal 用户 signal:UUID 授予访问权限
say.note: 创建用户并授予 owner 角色、加入分组

howto.what_en: Once installed, NanoClaw talks with Signal through a native signal-cli adapter: scan a QR from your phone to join as a secondary device, and the assistant sends and receives as that phone number in DMs, groups, and Note to Self.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want Signal added as a channel, usually inside the /setup flow or on its own. Wire it afterward with /init-first-agent or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add Signal and link my account by QR code
say_en.note: Installs signal-cli and prints a link QR

say_en.text: Wire this Signal group to my agent
say_en.note: Creates the wiring for that group

say_en.text: Grant access to Signal user signal:UUID
say_en.note: Adds user, owner role, group membership
